scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => fs.rmSync(f, { force: true })); if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev: node -e "process.env.PORT = process.env.PORT || '5000'; process.env.BASE_PATH = process.env.BASE_PATH || '/'; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('pnpm --filter @workspace/portfolio run dev', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
